description: Job Title: Associate Quality Analyst – Histology Analyst II Job Description The Associate Quality Analyst (Histology Analyst II) performs and documents complex histological testing in support of Quality, R&D, Clinical, Complaints, and Tissue Services functions. This role covers all phases of tissue preparation for paraffin and frozen techniques, including routine H&E staining, special stains (histochemistry), immunohistochemistry, microscopy, and image analysis. The analyst serves as a key quality gate for product release, maintains and qualifies histology equipment, updates documentation, supports audits and inspections, and trains peers and technicians. This position offers opportunities to learn and develop advanced techniques such as in-situ hybridization, electron microscopy, bone histology, method and process validation, and Lean/Six Sigma principles. Responsibilities Act as the final quality check on products prior to release by proficiently performing histology analysis and evaluating stain results to determine whether findings are due to histological processing or production processes. Exercise discretion to fail product when appropriate and initiate, report, and investigate out-of-specification (OOS) results through the Quality Management System. Evaluate R&D, clinical, donor, and control tissue samples as requested, ensuring accurate and timely histological assessment. Collaborate with Medical Directors, scientists, and cross-functional teams to examine product tissue, donor tissue, clinical samples, and R&D study samples. Apply knowledge of gross anatomy and study objectives to dissect representative tissue samples and select appropriate stains for histology testing and analysis. Proficiently perform histology testing for QC product release samples, clinical complaint cases, donor samples, R&D, and engineering studies, including decalcification, rehydration, grossing, fixation, embedding, microtomy, routine staining, special stains (histochemistry), and immunohistochemistry. Conduct peer review of histology sample preparation steps to verify compliance with standard operating procedures and current GxP requirements. Develop in-depth knowledge of relevant scientific technologies to enhance current histological techniques and support evolving needs of internal customers. Draft, revise, and update Standard Operating Procedures and related controlled documents to reflect current practices and regulatory expectations. Participate in the training and development of technicians and peers in histological sample handling, histochemical and immunohistochemical techniques, imaging, and analysis. Actively support and adhere to the Quality System by diligently participating in compliance-related activities and following company work standards and Code of Conduct. Prepare reagents and solutions for fixation and staining techniques, and select appropriate materials and instrumentation from qualified suppliers. Operate, maintain, and qualify or valid

Job Title: Labor Compliance Specialist – Certified Payroll Job Description This role focuses on ensuring full labor and payroll compliance across multiple construction projects by actively monitoring certified payroll records, managing subcontractor setup and documentation in a labor compliance platform, and supporting internal and external audits. The position works closely with subcontractors, field teams, consultants, and project managers to verify adherence to federal, IRA, and construction-related labor requirements and to provide clear, data-driven compliance reporting. Responsibilities Actively monitor certified payroll records on a weekly basis and review subcontractor submissions in the labor compliance platform (LCPtracker). Review each certified payroll report in LCPtracker, including those from lower-tier subcontractors, to confirm that all required documentation is received and complete. Issue notifications to subcontractors regarding deficiencies or missing information and alert field teams when subcontractors are non-compliant. Make informed recommendations for withholding payment when subcontractors do not meet labor compliance requirements. Manage the subcontractor setup process in the labor compliance platform, including issuing welcome packets outlining compliance requirements. Add subcontractors to LCPtracker, assign them to the appropriate projects, and ensure all major scope subcontractors are properly associated with projects under construction. Assist the team with drafting site-specific Project Determination Summaries to document applicable wage and compliance requirements. Identify wage tables that need to be created or updated in LCPtracker, coordinate their creation with the team, and assign the correct wage tables to each project. Assist with adding new users to LCPtracker and ensuring they have appropriate access and guidance. Oversee the general labor compliance email inbox, respond to subcontractor inquiries, and screen or assign emails to the appropriate team members as needed. Act as a liaison between third-party consultants, subcontractors, and the internal Labor Compliance Team to facilitate clear communication and timely issue resolution. Maintain a subcontractor compliance log for each project to track labor compliance status and support project managers in determining eligibility for invoice approvals. Resolve certified payroll reporting inquiries from both internal stakeholders and external clients. Assist with external certified payroll audits and other requests from third parties, ensuring accurate and timely responses. Attend compliance meetings and trainings focused on IRA bill compliance, Department of Labor payroll requirements, and apprenticeship requirements, and apply this knowledge to daily work. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of contractual obligations in order to effectively audit incoming certified payroll documents. Provide monthly compliance summaries for each project to support

Job Title: Compliance Analyst Job Description The Quality Assurance Associate assists in the management, administration, and maintenance of the Quality System to ensure compliance with internal standards and external regulatory requirements. This role is responsible for verifying that products are manufactured in accordance with applicable procedures and specifications in a cGMP-compliant manner. The associate partners closely with manufacturing and operations throughout the production life cycle to ensure procedures are followed, activities are appropriately documented, and products are released in alignment with quality and regulatory expectations. Responsibilities Communicate and partner on a continuous, daily basis with production management to understand and support activities on the production floor. Issue batch records and ensure they are complete, accurate, and available to support production activities. Routinely review production floor activities and documentation to verify compliance with established procedures and quality requirements. Stay current with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs) related to shop floor practices, including cleaning, room conditions, changeovers, and line clearance, and verify ongoing compliance with these SOPs. Support production management in developing and conducting training related to quality procedures, documentation practices, and shop floor compliance. Manage quality events associated with production activities by using risk-based principles to assess events, determine appropriate actions, and ensure timely and thorough resolution. Manage deviations by coordinating, documenting, and supporting investigations as required, ensuring that root causes and corrective actions are clearly defined. Review completed batch records and perform product release activities as authorized by the Quality Assurance leadership, ensuring all quality and regulatory requirements are met prior to release. Ensure proper filing, storage, and control of quality documentation to maintain data integrity, traceability, and audit readiness. Sample raw materials and packaging components as needed to help the department meet quality and production timelines. Author and edit SOPs in collaboration with Quality Assurance leadership to ensure procedures are clear, current, and aligned with regulatory expectations. Support Quality Assurance leadership in conducting departmental training and facilitating workflow within the quality function to improve efficiency and consistency. Work closely with Quality Assurance leadership to streamline existing processes and develop new processes and procedures that enhance business performance and quality outcomes. Support the preparation and regular presentation of quality assurance program elements, including metrics and trends, to site leadership through formal Management Review. Essential Skills Minimum 3 years of experience in quality assurance within a drug and/or cGMP-regulated environ
